play_against_summary: AoE and explosive damage can be used to destroy multiple barrier panels at once.
Dive counters her playstyle. Overwhelm her by quickly getting behind her barrier.
If a teammate gets imprisoned by her ult. Help them destroy the barrier from the outside.
Force her to use bubbles early or inefficiently by threatening burst damage or dives, then momentarily disengaging.

Play around her energy level. A high-energy 
Zarya
 is far more lethal, so respect her threat in fights and avoid extended duels when she has maximum charge.
Avoid clumping together when she has Grav. Position where it's difficult for her to target you, or save defensive abilities to save yourself and teammates.

Force 
Sigma
 off his optimal mid-range poke angles by pressuring him with dive or flank threats, exploiting his lack of mobility.

Beam heroes are strong against 
Sigma
 because they can burn through his shield and 
Kinetic Grasp
 doesn't absorb beams.

Stun him out of 
Gravitic Flux
 to immediately cancel his ult before he has a chance to activate.
Keep your distance. Tracer has terrible ranged damage so try to position where it's difficult for her to reach you, or use mobility tools to dodge her.

Track 
Recall
. You can get used to the timing of Recall to predict where she will rewind to. If you see Recall used, that is your chance to chase and eliminate Tracer.

If you see Tracer multi-Blink straight at you, expect a 
Pulse Bomb
. Use a barrier, stun, or escape tool to avoid getting stuck.
Maintain distance. Save your escape tool for when you see her use her sword toss dash. She can’t chase you if you reposition after.
The moment she arrives, focus her. She won’t be able to escape for a few seconds, and that is your team’s best opportunity to punish her.
Use crowd control to neutralize her. She can only try to dodge it as her shield does not absorb CC.
Watch for charged Railgun shots. When she hasn’t fired one for a few seconds, position out of her LoS.

When you hear 
Overclock
, find cover and hide. On occasions where that isn’t possible, immediately focus her.
After she uses Power Slide, quickly dive her. She won’t be able to escape and likely has low Railgun charge.

Force out 
Swift Step
 or 
Protection Suzu
 early, then re-engage while those cooldowns are unavailable.
Pressure her from multiple angles to deny safe teleport targets and limit her escape options.

Treat 
Kitsune Rush
 like the best offensive ult the enemy team has. Save defensive utility to survive, retreat when possible, or use your own ultimates to prevent her from overwhelming your team.

Illari
 has great ranged damage, but struggles with close-range duels. Try to avoid her LoS until you can catch her in a close-range fight.

Teams with Illari are at a disadvantage in longer fights that require a lot of sustain. Play patient and only commit to the attack after she’s lost her 
Healing Pylon
 and used up her Solar Energy.
When you hear her ult voice line, prepare your countermeasures. Shoot her out of the sky, block the projectile, stun her before she fires, or escape out of her LoS.

Create crossfire. Attacking 
D.Va
 from multiple directions stops her from Matrixing all your team's damage.
Stay together. Focus on keeping each other alive and forcing her to retreat. Every time she leaves close range, her value goes way down.

D.Va
 has no protection against beam and melee attacks. If you’re struggling, consider swapping to counter.

Track his cooldowns. When 
Winston
 uses either bubble or leap, his enemies have a generous window to target him where he can’t shield or jump away. Focus him when he can’t escape.

Keep your distance. Most heroes have CC to stop or knockback 
Winston
, or a movement ability to run away. Try to never let him get close to you, as he’s only a threat up close.

Stay in an ally Support’s LoS. 
Winston
's damage is rather low, and most Supports can keep you alive with their healing even while he’s attacking you. Eventually, you’ll do more damage than him, and he’ll have to disengage.
If you react quickly with healing, CC, or damage mitigation when an ally gets Hooked, you can save their life.

When Hook misses or gets blocked, press the attack for a few seconds because 
Roadhog
 is not very lethal without 
Chain Hook
.

If you have a damage mitigation ability, let 
Whole Hog
 push you back so you get out of its optimal range before activating your barrier or damage absorption.
If you don’t have good burst damage, try to escape during his Siphon Blaster, so you minimize how much life steal he can generate.
Emre has no crowd control counters other than trying to dodge with Siphon Blasters. He’s an easy kill if you can stun or knock him around.
Listen for his Ult voice line, and prepare to shoot Emre out of the sky.

Close the distance. 
Ashe
 struggles in close-range fights. Find ways to approach her and shut her down.

Keep track of 
Dynamite
's 12-second cooldown. If she just used it, you can move up. If she hasn’t thrown it for a while, try to stand outside of her throw range.

Hide from 
B.O.B.
 He has a huge health pool, so if your team can’t burst him down quickly, it's best to get out of his LoS and wait until he leaves.

Hitscans like 
Soldier: 76
 have the advantage against Echo when she’s flying around.
Pay attention and notice if you don’t see Echo. She’s likely setting up behind you for a sneak attack, so watch your flank.

Many Echo players use Flight to get in and attack. Dodge and get cover for a few seconds, then quickly focus her while her 
Flight
 is on cooldown.

Plan to counter 
Flashbang
. If your hero has a way to block or dodge Flashbang, be sure to save it when getting into close range against a Cassidy.

Position outside his optimal range. Many heroes like 
Ashe
, 
Freja
, 
Ana
, and 
Zenyatta
 have the upper hand in long-range fights against Cassidy.

Watch for 
Deadeye
. If you don’t see Cassidy for a bit, he’s likely setting up a flank Deadeye. Stay near cover; you can hide behind it or prepare your counterattack.

Shoot the 
Sentry Turret
s. Don’t be the teammate who walks forward, gets blasted by the turrets, and ignores them. On corners, you can quickly peek and fire before they target you.
Watch for TP. Her team might end up behind you and wipe your backline. Sym may also use TP to dive an isolated target, so always watch to see if her hands are up in the deploy animation.
Stay out of her effective range. Primary fire and turrets both have very limited ranges, so most heroes have the advantage against Sym at medium to long range.
Dive him. Every role has heroes who can go with another ally and dive Soldier. He doesn’t have any CC and can’t attack while using his mobility tool.
Block his poke damage. If all Soldier is doing is shooting barriers, he’s not bringing a lot of value to his team. Either use your own shield or play in the protection of a teammate.
If you don’t see Soldier in front of you for a while, assume he is about to attack you from your flank. Play near cover so you can escape his surprise attack.
Don’t get isolated. Genji is one of the best 1v1 duelists in OW, so stay close to your allies so he always has to fight at least two enemies.

Force out 
Deflect
 by dealing damage with your standard weapon, then use your cooldown abilities to punish him when he doesn’t have it.

Dragonblade
 is extremely lethal and can instantly win team fights. Plan how you will personally survive it, and how you can help your teammates survive with your healing, burst damage, or CC.
Sleep Dart is Ana’s primary means of survival. If you see her shoot it or sleep an ally, that is your signal to go attack her.
When playing Tank or any dive hero, you’ll need to play around anti-nades. Try to predict her timing and use your mitigation or evade ability to make sure you don’t get anti-healed.

Don’t overcommit to trying to kill her Tank if she hasn’t used Nano in a while. After you use up your cooldowns trying to get the kill, she’ll Nano the Tank, and their counterattack will be too much for you to survive.
Stay outside his effective range. His abilities are close to medium-ranged, so attack him from distances where he cannot coutner attack.
His single-target healing is low; you can burst down his allies even when he’s trying to heal them.
Go inside his ultimate and force his team out. If you have melee or beam abilities, you can penetrate the Sanctuary walls.

When you see the 
Guardian Wave
 slam, back off, wait a few seconds, then hard re-engage to wipe his team because they won’t have burst healing.
After you see him use Rushing Torrent (often to refill healing resources), immediately rush at him to eliminate Wuyang while he’s unable to escape.
His Ult has a short 3.5s duration. Run away, use cover, and escape tools your hero has because it’s basically impossible to survive if you get caught.

Every time you see 
Hazard
 use 
Spike Guard
, use your crowd control abilities on him.
Plan how you will survive his dive. You can use escape abilities, damage mitigation, stuns, or position near an ally who can assist you.

Counterswap when necessary. Examples: 
Ana
 can sleep and anti him; 
Echo
 can avoid him, then burst combo him to death after he blocks; 
Roadhog
 can interrupt his dives with Hook.

Use stuns and knock back to shut down his approach. If he can't get into 
Rocket Hammer
 range, he's very underwhelming.
Burn his barrier from off-angles rather than stacking in front of it where his team can safely attack you.

When you see the Enemy walking suspiciously far up, expect
Earthshatter
. The moment you see him drop the shield and wind up, use your barrier or escape ability.

CC her. 
Junker Queen
 has no countermeasure to CC. Stun and knock her around to keep her at bay.
Keep your distance. Keep moving and try to never let her get into axe range.

Shoot her team. JQ has a lot of self-healing and can be difficult to kill. But she’s smaller for a 
Tank
 and can’t protect her team from your damage.

Save your damage mitigation or mobility abilities to prevent him from damaging you during 
Cardiac Overdrive
.

Mauga
 can’t be stopped during 
Overrun
. Position out of his charge range, or prepare to dodge him.

When he has 
Cage Fight
 ready, either play spread so you don’t get caught, or get everyone inside so you and your team can help each other survive the ult.

Ignore 
Orisa
. The best way to counter 
Orisa
 is to avoid her and target the rest of her team. She’ll try to stop you, but she can’t chase you down.

Wait out 
Fortify
. If you see her golden, either hide so you don’t take damage, or switch targets, and attack someone else.

Go beams. If all else fails, the easiest way to counter 
Orisa
 is to play a beam hero. 
Orisa
 is free ult charge to them.

While he’s blocking or charging 
Rocket Punch
, stun him. He’s sitting still, and cancelling his 
Power Block
 is the best method for eliminating 
Doomfist
.

Dodge his engage attack. Keep track of 
Doomfist
 and watch for when he’s coming in with 
Seismic Slam
 or 
Rocket Punch
. If you dodge his initial attack, he misses out on overhealth and will have to reset.

To counter 
Doomfist
, play heroes with stuns or high mobility heroes who can evade him. If you can’t run away or stun him, 
Doomfist
 will harass you all game.

Heroes with the mobility and range to stay outside of the 10m range of 
Fan the Flames
 have an advantage in the match-up.

Crowd Control and stuns are very effective for shutting down 
Anran
's rush. Target her and finish her off when she tries to escape.

Quickly target 
Anran
 during her ult. If she’s at low HP or takes a second to aim, you can eliminate her while she’s channeling 
Vermillion Ascent
.
Turret form only lasts for 6 seconds. Most of the time, your best play is to hide and wait for a few seconds. Don’t peek or else you’ll be killed or have to waste resources to not die.

Attack aggressively after his turret mode ends. His damage is low in Recon so you can ignore him and target his 
Support
s during his 
Configuration: Assault
 cooldown.

Heroes with damage mitigation to shut down his turret form, or the mobility to outrun him, are the best counters. The key to beating 
Bastion
 comps is to minimize the value he gets from each 
Configuration: Assault
 use.
Freja excels at focusing down one target, but is weak when there are multiple enemies. Position near your allies so you don’t end up in a 1v1 situation.
Counter Freja by outranging her with a hitscan sniper, or overwhelming her with a close-range, high mobility hero.
Respect his sightlines. If he’s already aiming down the main choke point, stay behind a barrier or take a different path.
Vary your left/right strafing movement to make it more difficult for him to predict your direction.
If you are playing a flank or dive hero, keep pressuring him so he can’t freely shoot the rest of your team.
Avoid tight corridors, rooms, hallways, and low areas. These are the perfect places for Junkrat’s frags to farm your team.
Keep an eye on the floor. Break traps for your teammates so they don’t walk in and die.
Heroes with long-range capabilities or small, high-mobility characters have favorable matchups against Junkrat.
Venture can still be damaged after activating Burrow until their entire body is fully submerged. Don't let them get away!

Make a mental note if you don't see 
Venture
 on your screen. They are likely setting up a flank attack, so be ready to counter.

When they miss abilities, or you see them use 
Drill Dash
 and 
Burrow
, that's your signal to hard-focus them at their most vulnerable.

Focus him after Wraith. Even if you have to chase after him, a Reaper without 
Wraith Form
 is an easy kill.

Listen for 
Shadow Step
 sound cue. Whichever direction you hear it from tells you he’s about to appear and attack you.

Counter 
Death Blossom
 with CC, damage mitigation, or focus fire. He’s moving slowly and can’t cancel Blossom, so he’s easy to target.
Break her wall! Shoot a single pillar to quickly create an opening for trapped teammates to walk through.

Play around her cooldowns. When she has 
Ice Wall
, don’t casually walk through a choke and get walled off. Wait until she’s used it before pushing up.
Stay outside her primary fire range. Her secondary fire range is less consistent and easier to deal with.
Force her to retreat with dives and flanks. Even if you don’t get the kill, stop her from aiming at your teammates.
Never peek the same angle twice. If you see Widow aiming down sights, don’t walk out at the same position because she will be ready to hit the shot.
Avoid her sightlines. Scout or get info from your team about her position. Then take side routes where she can’t snipe you.
Break his Turret first. Try quickly peeking around corners and hiding between your own shots to minimize the Turret's damage.
Bait out Overload. Soft engage without committing all your long cooldowns, then back up when he’s using Overload. It only lasts five seconds, and you can attack again as soon as it ends.
Play ranged heroes. Torb is weaker against heroes with range because they can break his Turret from safety and have more consistent damage than his primary fire.
Don’t commit long cooldowns or ultimates until after you’ve seen him use Immortality Field. Try to attack with your standard attacks or short CDs, retreat, then re-engage after he’s used it.
Watch his jumps, and track him in the air. He’s easiest to elim while he’s locked in the jump arc.
His primary fire has severe damage falloff. Keep your distance and take him down with heroes like Ana, Kiri, and Widowmaker.

Keep poking her. 
Juno
 can’t heal herself, so she relies on shield regen and the Support heal passive. Even the smallest amount of damage to her interrupts the passive self-heal.

All of 
Juno
's healing requires LoS. Stop her from healing with barriers or by forcing her attention away from her allies through your attacks.

Without Pulsar Torpedoes, 
Juno
 struggles to defend herself against high mobility heroes. Get past her team and chase her down.
Don’t let her get off free resurrections. If her teammate dies, expect her to be looking for an opportunity to rez. Be ready to punish her.
Bait out Guardian Angel without using your movement ability. Then chase her for the kill.

Target 
Mercy
 . Eliminating Mercy first is more efficient than trying to kill her allies through her healing.

Zenyatta
 can’t escape flank and dive attacks. Coordinate with at least one teammate and surprise attack him simultaneously for an easy kill.

Cleanse 
Orb of Discord
 by breaking LoS before committing to your attack. You don’t want to move in deep just to get blown up by the extra Discord damage.

If you don’t see 
Zenyatta
 , assume he is charging up a volley. Get behind a barrier and watch your flank.
Poke. Brig can’t directly deal with poke damage, and it's a great way to pressure her Shield and keep her playing passively.

Soft engage to get 
Whip Shot
out, then use movement cooldowns when she can’t knock you away.
Target her allies. Brig’s healing is pretty slow, so often the best strategy is to kill the rest of her team first, then her last.

Track his 
Adaptive Shield
. If he hasn’t used them, don’t use your stuns yet, or he’ll easily survive.
Pick a hero with kockbacks or stuns. Dealing with Ball is very hard without good CC.
Don’t get isolated. Instead, position with at least one teammate so you don’t get caught in a 1v1 with Ball.

Ramattra
 is less tanky and less lethal in Omnic Form. After Nemesis ends, that is your window to go on the offensive.

Break line of sight (LoS) on his ultimate to end it quickly. Cutting off 
Annihilation
's AoE for a total of 3 seconds will immediately cancel it.
If Ram is walking toward you, expect a Vortex. Use mobility or cover before he throws it.

The best way to deal with 
Pharah
 is to play a hitscan with range and burst damage like 
Ashe
 or 
Illari
.
Deny her safe air space by controlling high ground and forcing her to play predictable sightlines.
Track her Barrage and hold defensive cooldowns or burst abilities to punish her immediately when she commits. A slight delay will make the difference between dying and taking her out.
Be on the lookout for Sombra if you haven’t seen her for a while; that means she’s in position to flank you. Be ready to turn around and counterattack.
If she Translocates right into your team, assume EMP is coming. CC her, dash away, or get to cover.

Heroes with mobility like 
D.Va
 and 
Anran
 can chase after Translocate and shoot Sombra out of invis for the kill.

Track her 
Fade
 cooldown and pressure her aggressively once it has been used, as she is highly vulnerable without mobility.
Avoid giving her free resource generation by minimizing unnecessary poke damage and positioning outside of her Biotic Grasp range.

Focus her during 
Coalescence
 with burst damage or crowd control, she'll either be forced to Fade away, or be vulnerable to elimination during the ult.

Focus your dives and flanks on 
Lifeweaver
 . He won’t be personally killing you, so your only hindrance is his allies' protection.
Save your best cooldowns until after Life Grip has been used. After you’ve seen someone get pulled, you have a long window of time to attack where your target can’t be saved by Grip.

Pick a hero with vertical mobility. 
Lifeweaver
 can easily avoid you if you can’t chase him vertically when he uses 
Petal Platform
.
